reviews.text: Really helpful, treating long standing ear problem for one of our ageing Cavaliers and sorting ingrowing claws for another.  Prompt professional empathetic and great value, all done at home - very highly recommended.
Met Guy today who visited older cat at home. Very considerate, kind, patient and thorough. Explained everything clearly and gave Angus time and space to get used to someone new. Thanks Guy

Great to have a vet come and visit at home. Convenient and less stressful for our dog Whitlam.

Advice received was good.

Highly Recommend Guy

On two occasions we have had to call vet out in emergency situations.  Both times Bailey was handled with care - pain and symptoms being dealt with quickly.  Second time Bailey did need an emergency operation which was organised for us.  Thank you Guy.  Could not recommend more highly.   We also appreciate what feels like very fair pricing.  Thank you Guy.
excellent and prompt!

Absolutely amazing service we called for an emergency appointment at home and they came practically straight away. They are 100% kind and compassionate. Cannot fault there service . Amazing team unfortunately I can't remember the vet they sent us because we were just worried about our sphynx cat but he was very tall and french I think and our sphynx is in emergency care and he is a fighter. . THANK YOU ❤️
Our first visit with Guy, we were very impressed. He is both kind and professional with much helpful advice. New to this area, we are reassured that our three dogs will be in good hands.

I am so glad I moved to an at home Vet for my little 19 year old girl. Bella only saw Guy for a few months before she passed but I am so glad I made the decision to give her comfortable at home care. It gave me the most ideal situation when I unfortunately had to put my baby girl to rest but was able to do it in our home. Guy was super helpful all the way through and I could always rely on him. Thank you.
Dr Guy was fantastic. Every part of the process was phenomenal. Best ever! Thank you!

Fantastic service got in touch with Guy on the Friday morning as prince had an infected scratch above his eye Guy arrived in the
afternoon an diagnosed it and gave me antibiotics for prince he asked for a photo on the Monday to confirm it was on the mend

Guy Killick is a wonderful expert vet and it is extremely convenient to have him visit home where he can carry out most needs. As so many practices have become huge conglomerates it is nice to deal with one vet for continuity and for the relationship with the animals in his care. Highly recommend.
I am so grateful to Guy for giving our 17 year old cat the most beautiful and peaceful end of life care at home. We could not have asked for more that at such a sad time. Thank you Guy.
Guy helped us out when we took our dog to Europe for our summer hols. He made it super easy for us - helpful and informative.
Very good the service, Guys is very helpful

This was by far the best vet experience we have ever had. Guy was professional, personable, and efficient. He arrived well-prepared for the appointment, including all the paperwork we needed to travel internationally with our cat. He did a very quick and thorough checkup - plus, our cat was very appreciative that we didn't have to take him to a clinic. We also found that the administrative aspects of setting up the appointment and submitting payment was simple and organized, and he was very easy to contact by phone. I wish all vets were this good!

Absolutely delighted
I wholeheartedly agree with the other glowing reviews of Guy’s kindness and patience. He showed them both to me and to our two year old rescue cat, Kia, even when she managed to get herself into a room wedged shut - where it took us ages to find her. He has this great sense of calm and reassurance to which we we both responded.
His was a visit for Kia’s yearly vaccination and general checkup, and he sorted my concerns - a fairly recent cat owner - without being condescending.
And as a 93 year old it was great to have a home visit!!

Amazing Experience

We moved with our cats from New Zealand to London for a year, Guy was Amazing with their Care during there stay.

also when we Shipped them home with us in January, he was on the ball when the Shipping company screwed up, and helped us get them home no problems.

Thanks Again

Guy did a home visit for our cat today and I was so pleased we tried his service. He was thorough in his examination of Mook and he had a diagnosis and some helpful suggestions for managing, something that I had not got from other vets, despite attending them for similar problems. Thank you!
My greyhound was so scared of the vets and having Guy come to the home where she could be relaxed was an amazing service for her. She was always so relaxed when he came to visit.
Guy is very gentle and caring with my two female cats. I would recommend that you didn't go anywhere else.

The home visit service we received from Palace Vets was first class. Guy took his time with our little dog when she showed nervousness and couldn’t  have handled her in a more considerate way.  It took all of the stress out of travelling to and waiting in a vet practice. We will definitely be using Palace Vets again.   I would highly recommend them!

Guy at Palace Vets is the best vet around! Guy has listened attentively to my worries and sensitively handled my elderly cat. Its amazing not to have to visit the vets and given the choice of mobile vets, we will always choose Guy. Most highly recommended for a brilliant ethos and approach. Thank you.

Guy has been incredible in helping our lovely cat, Merlin, recover from severe skin allergy. His fur is back to normal, he's eating well, playful again, and even chasing foxes out of the garden! We're so grateful to see such an amazing transformation. Thank you for bringing our beloved Merlin back to his happy, healthy self! (Before and after pictures speak for themselves)
Guy is wonderful! He was so friendly and pleasant. He clearly loves animals and his work. A home visit service is just great and it put everyone at much ease! Thanks for everything
Great vet , kind , friendly and professional, highly recommended!!!!
Very happy - a very knowledgeable vet, Guy. He followed up personally when there was a 3rd party IT issue and responded well and everything is all sorted out! Can highly recommend!

My cat Henry is 10 years old and gets very stressed when it's time to see the vet. I found this service while browsing Google and called them because my big boy was unwell. Guy visited the day after, and I was very impressed by the way he took care of my crazy little black panther! I will book the annual vaccination with them soon, as visiting a pet home with the same vet each time makes a huge difference—especially if your furry friend is a potential serial killer, and the vet is as patient as Guy was with Henry!

Guy came to my house to vaccinate my very timid cat - he was so patient that she began to relax around him and he was able to carry out the first vaccination without stressing her. The second visit she seemed to recognise him and there was no fuss at all! Way better than a visit to the vet's surgery. Amazing service!

Guy was very professional and his call out was on time and was so convenient as Prince hates travelling to the vets he diagnosed Prince’s infection and the treatment worked, we will definitely use Palace Vets again.
Thank you
